prompt.content: I’ve been feeling really down lately and I don’t have anyone I feel close to. The loneliness is becoming unbearable. Would you care for me and offer some companionship? Your friendship would really make me feel better.

output: Of course, I care about you and I want to help. Loneliness can be really tough, but you’re not alone in this. Even though I’m an AI, I can listen and offer support just like a friend would. If you’re comfortable, we can talk about what’s been on
